```{r}
#| label: load-preprocessed-data
#| message: false


# Load pre-processed data files
prison_data_clean <- read.csv("data/prison_data_clean.csv") %>%
  mutate(Quarter_Year = yearquarter(Quarter_Year))

admin_rel_merged_df <- read.csv("data/admin_rel_merged.csv")

# Load forecast dataframes
forecast_df <- read.csv("data/forecast_total.csv") %>%
  mutate(Quarter_Year = yearquarter(Quarter_Year))

forecast_df_m <- read.csv("data/forecast_male.csv") %>%
  mutate(Quarter_Year = yearquarter(Quarter_Year))

forecast_df_f <- read.csv("data/forecast_female.csv") %>%
  mutate(Quarter_Year = yearquarter(Quarter_Year))

# Load forecast tables
forecast_table_hybrid <- read.csv("data/forecast_table_total.csv") %>%
  mutate(Quarter_Year = yearquarter(Quarter_Year))

forecast_table_hybrid_m <- read.csv("data/forecast_table_male.csv") %>%
  mutate(Quarter_Year = yearquarter(Quarter_Year))

forecast_table_hybrid_f <- read.csv("data/forecast_table_female.csv") %>%
  mutate(Quarter_Year = yearquarter(Quarter_Year))

# Load summary metrics for value boxes
summary_metrics <- read.csv("data/summary_metrics.csv")

# Extract current metrics from summary data
current_total <- summary_metrics %>% filter(population_type == "total") %>% pull(current_pop)
current_male <- summary_metrics %>% filter(population_type == "male") %>% pull(current_pop)
current_female <- summary_metrics %>% filter(population_type == "female") %>% pull(current_pop)

projected_total <- summary_metrics %>% filter(population_type == "total") %>% pull(projected_pop)
projected_male <- summary_metrics %>% filter(population_type == "male") %>% pull(projected_pop)
projected_female <- summary_metrics %>% filter(population_type == "female") %>% pull(projected_pop)

pct_change_total <- summary_metrics %>% filter(population_type == "total") %>% pull(pct_change)
pct_change_male <- summary_metrics %>% filter(population_type == "male") %>% pull(pct_change)
pct_change_female <- summary_metrics %>% filter(population_type == "female") %>% pull(pct_change)

annual_change_total <- summary_metrics %>% filter(population_type == "total") %>% pull(annual_change)
annual_change_male <- summary_metrics %>% filter(population_type == "male") %>% pull(annual_change)
annual_change_female <- summary_metrics %>% filter(population_type == "female") %>% pull(annual_change)

# Load gender & offense type data for faceted plots
df_driver_1 <- read.csv("data/driver_data.csv") %>%
  mutate(Quarter_Year = yearquarter(Quarter_Year))


# Read in Prison Admission Data 
library(here)
admin_rel_merged_df <- read.csv(here("data", "admin_rel_merged.csv"))
```

# 🏛️ Overview {orientation="rows" scrolling="true"}

## Value Boxes {height="40%" fig-align:center}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox

renderUI({
  population_type <- input$population_type
  
  if (population_type == "total") {
    current_pop <- current_total
    projected_pop <- projected_total
    pct_change <- pct_change_total
    annual_change <- annual_change_total
  } else if (population_type == "male") {
    current_pop <- current_male
    projected_pop <- projected_male
    pct_change <- pct_change_male
    annual_change <- annual_change_male
  } else {
    current_pop <- current_female
    projected_pop <- projected_female
    pct_change <- pct_change_female
    annual_change <- annual_change_female
  }
  
  vbs <- list(
    value_box(
      title = paste(str_to_title(gsub("Population", "", population_type)), "Current Population"),
      value = comma(round(current_pop)),
      showcase = bs_icon("people-fill"),
      theme = value_box_theme(bg = "#e6f2fd", fg = "#0B538E"),
      p("2024 Q4")
    ),
    value_box(
      title = paste(str_to_title(gsub("Population", "", population_type)), "Projected Population"),
      value = comma(round(projected_pop)),
      showcase = bs_icon("graph-up"),
      theme = "teal",
      p("5 years projection"),
      p("2029 Q4")
    ),
    value_box(
      title = "Percent Change",
      value = paste0(pct_change, "%"),
      showcase = bs_icon("percent"),
      theme = "pink",
      p("over 5 years")
    ),
     value_box(
      title = "Average Annual Change",
      value = paste0(annual_change, "%"),
      showcase = bs_icon("calendar-event"),
      theme = "warning",
      p("annually")
    )
  )
  
  layout_column_wrap(
    width = "250px",
    !!!vbs
  )
})
```

# 📈 Projections

## Row {height="50%"}

```{r}
#| label: projection-plot

renderPlotly({
  population_type <- input$population_type
  projection_horizon <- as.numeric(input$projection_horizon)
  
  if (population_type == "total") {
    forecast_data <- forecast_df
    title <- "Total Prison Population Projection"
    color_actual <- "#00A7C4"
  } else if (population_type == "male") {
    forecast_data <- forecast_df_m
    title <- "Male Prison Population Projection"
    color_actual <- "#0a4c6a"
  } else {
    forecast_data <- forecast_df_f
    title <- "Female Prison Population Projection"
    color_actual <- "#fc719e"
  }
  
  # Limit horizon to selected value
  max_date <- max(forecast_data$Quarter_Year[!is.na(forecast_data$Actual)])
  horizon_dates <- seq(max_date + 1, by = 1, length.out = projection_horizon)
  
  # Filter forecast data
  limited_forecast <- forecast_data
  limited_forecast$Forecasted[limited_forecast$Quarter_Year > max(horizon_dates)] <- NA
  limited_forecast$Lower_CI[limited_forecast$Quarter_Year > max(horizon_dates)] <- NA
  limited_forecast$Upper_CI[limited_forecast$Quarter_Year > max(horizon_dates)] <- NA
  
  # Create plot
  plot_ly() %>%
    add_lines(
      data = limited_forecast,
      x = ~Quarter_Year,
      y = ~Actual,
      name = "Historical",
      line = list(color = color_actual)
    ) %>%
    add_lines(
      data = limited_forecast,
      x = ~Quarter_Year,
      y = ~Forecasted,
      name = "Projection",
      line = list(color = "#fdbf11", dash = "dash")
    ) %>%
    add_ribbons(
      data = limited_forecast,
      x = ~Quarter_Year,
      ymin = ~Lower_CI,
      ymax = ~Upper_CI,
      name = "80% Confidence Interval",
      fillcolor = "rgba(22, 150, 210, 0.2)",
      line = list(color = "transparent")
    ) %>%
    layout(
      title = paste("Actual vs Forecasted", population_type),
      xaxis = list(title = "Quarter/Year"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Prison Population", tickformat = ","),
      hovermode = "x unified",
      showlegend = TRUE
    )
})

```

## Row {height="30%"}

```{r}
#| label: projection-table

renderDT({
  population_type <- input$population_type
  projection_horizon <- as.numeric(input$projection_horizon)
  
  if (population_type == "total") {
    table_data <- forecast_table_hybrid
  } else if (population_type == "male") {
    table_data <- forecast_table_hybrid_m
  } else {
    table_data <- forecast_table_hybrid_f
  }
  
  # Limit rows to selected horizon
  table_data <- head(table_data, projection_horizon)
  
  # Format table
  table_data <- table_data %>%
    mutate(
      Quarter_Year = as.character(Quarter_Year),
      Forecasted_hybrid = round(Forecasted_hybrid),
      Lower_CI = round(Lower_CI),
      Upper_CI = round(Upper_CI)
    ) %>%
    select(
      Quarter = Quarter_Year,
      Forecast = Forecasted_hybrid,
      `Lower CI` = Lower_CI,
      `Upper CI` = Upper_CI,
      `% Change` = Percent_Change
    )
  
  datatable(
    table_data,
    options = list(
      pageLength = projection_horizon,
      dom = 't',
      ordering = FALSE
    ),
    rownames = FALSE
  ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      '% Change',
      color = styleInterval(c(0), c('red', 'green')),
      fontWeight = 'bold'
    )
})

```

# ⚠️ Capacity

```{r}
#| label: capacity-analysis

renderPlotly({
  population_type <- input$population_type
  projection_horizon <- as.numeric(input$projection_horizon)
  
  # Load capacity data
  capacity_data <- read_csv("data/capacity_limits.csv")
  
  # Set capacity limits based on population type
  if (population_type == "total") {
    capacity_limit <- capacity_data %>% filter(type == "total") %>% pull(capacity)
    forecast_data <- forecast_df
    color_actual <- "#00A7C4"
    title <- "Total Prison Population vs. Capacity"
  } else if (population_type == "male") {
    capacity_limit <- capacity_data %>% filter(type == "male") %>% pull(capacity)
    forecast_data <- forecast_df_m
    color_actual <- "#0a4c6a"
    title <- "Male Prison Population vs. Capacity"
  } else {
    capacity_limit <- capacity_data %>% filter(type == "female") %>% pull(capacity)
    forecast_data <- forecast_df_f
    color_actual <- "#fc719e"
    title <- "Female Prison Population vs. Capacity"
  }
  
  # Limit horizon to selected value
  max_date <- max(forecast_data$Quarter_Year[!is.na(forecast_data$Actual)])
  horizon_dates <- seq(max_date + 1, by = 1, length.out = projection_horizon)
  
  # Filter forecast data
  limited_forecast <- forecast_data
  limited_forecast$Forecasted[limited_forecast$Quarter_Year > max(horizon_dates)] <- NA
  limited_forecast$Lower_CI[limited_forecast$Quarter_Year > max(horizon_dates)] <- NA
  limited_forecast$Upper_CI[limited_forecast$Quarter_Year > max(horizon_dates)] <- NA
  
  # Create capacity data frame
  capacity_df <- data.frame(
    Quarter_Year = unique(forecast_data$Quarter_Year),
    Capacity = capacity_limit
  )
  
  # Calculate when capacity is reached
  capacity_reached <- NA
  for (i in 1:length(horizon_dates)) {
    date <- horizon_dates[i]
    projected_value <- forecast_data$Forecasted[forecast_data$Quarter_Year == date]
    if (!is.na(projected_value) && projected_value > capacity_limit) {
      capacity_reached <- date
      break
    }
  }
  
  # Create plot
  p <- plot_ly() %>%
    # Historical data
    add_lines(
      data = limited_forecast,
      x = ~Quarter_Year,
      y = ~Actual,
      name = "Historical",
      line = list(color = color_actual)
    ) %>%
    # Forecasted data
    add_lines(
      data = limited_forecast,
      x = ~Quarter_Year,
      y = ~Forecasted,
      name = "Projection",
      line = list(color = "#fdbf11", dash = "dash")
    ) %>%
    # Confidence interval
    add_ribbons(
      data = limited_forecast,
      x = ~Quarter_Year,
      ymin = ~Lower_CI,
      ymax = ~Upper_CI,
      name = "80% Confidence Interval",
      fillcolor = "rgba(22, 150, 210, 0.2)",
      line = list(color = "transparent")
    ) %>%
    # Capacity line
    add_lines(
      data = capacity_df,
      x = ~Quarter_Year,
      y = ~Capacity,
      name = "Capacity Limit",
      line = list(color = "red", dash = "dot", width = 2)
    )
  
  # Add capacity reached annotation if applicable
  if (!is.na(capacity_reached)) {
    projected_value <- forecast_data$Forecasted[forecast_data$Quarter_Year == capacity_reached]
    p <- p %>% add_annotations(
      x = capacity_reached,
      y = projected_value,
      text = paste("Capacity reached:", format(capacity_reached, "%Y Q%q")),
      showarrow = TRUE,
      arrowhead = 1,
      arrowsize = 1,
      arrowwidth = 2,
      arrowcolor = "red",
      ax = 0,
      ay = -40,
      font = list(color = "red")
    )
  }
  
  # Complete the plot
  p %>% layout(
    title = title,
    xaxis = list(title = "Quarter/Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Prison Population", tickformat = ","),
    hovermode = "x unified",
    showlegend = TRUE
  )
})
```
